defect: single-bit crossing from clk_a to clk_b captured by one receiving stage
rationale: flag_a is asynchronous to clk_b and is captured by only one clk_b-domain register before flag_b is used.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Asynchronous flag_a crosses through a single flop with no second synchroniser stage.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the destination-domain register structure of the generic two-flop primitive and reduced it to a scalar self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Reduced the destination capture pipeline to one register, with stage_b directly sampling flag_a.
